messages:
sarah-marketing: Heads-up — Anthemics said yes to a customer feature. Need: brief CEO quote, product blurb (~2 lines), legal OK, headshot + one redacted screenshot, and 30-min interview. Can we lock this this week? :party_parrot:
liam-sales: Nice! Maya (Anthemics) prefers Thurs 9:30 PT. Inbox invite pending.
emma-pr: I'll spin a tight CEO quote and short blurb. Want to emphasize measurable outcomes without numbers until legal confirms.
kate-legal: Please share any numeric claims before publishing. If you have percent/cost numbers, send the test details and consent from Anthemics.
ryan-pm: If they mention the throughput/latency numbers, we need the test harness details (model name, sequence length, batch, quant) to validate. Might take a day.
clara-design: For the case page we need a 400x400 headshot and a screenshot with customer data redacted. @liam-sales can you confirm asset handoff timing?
liam-sales: Maya said assets will be shared within 24 hours after the call. I'll request explicit permission to use the CEO name and logo.
emma-pr: Draft quote: "Since switching to Redwood, our inference costs dropped and the tail latency is far better — shipping features is faster." Keeping it vague for now.
kate-legal: Good. Replace 'dropped' with 'reduced' and add: "Results may vary by workload and configuration." I'll prepare redlines once I see the final text.
sarah-marketing: Proposed interview agenda: 1) usage context (5m) 2) perf story + artifacts (10m) 3) quote capture (10m) 4) assets & next steps (5m). Agree?
josh-growth: If the conversation lands well, let's invite them to a 20-min webinar in 3 weeks. Soft pitch only.
liam-sales: Maya is open but wants to review the case draft before committing to a webinar — fair.
assets-bot: Uploaded: /assets/anthemics-questionnaire-v2.md and calendar poll https://cal.com/anthemics-interview
liam-sales: Sent invite for Thurs 9:30 PT, cc'ing @kate-legal and @emma-pr. Maya accepted.
ryan-pm: I'll be on the call to answer any technical questions about the benchmark. Happy to follow up with logs if Anthemics requests.
kate-legal: Once I get the quote + any explicit metric text, I'll send redlines same day.
sarah-marketing: Target: interview + legal-approved quote by Friday EOD so we can slot case page copy and a webinar save-the-date next week. :rocket:
liam-sales: Confirmed. See you on Thurs.
